title: Political finance: record types and dated source events
description: A source-navigation and interpretation asset, not a donor/party money dataset.
limitations: No donor totals, party rankings, suspicious-transaction matching or guilt scores are generated.
The three source events are selected historical context, not a complete chronology or live case-status tracker.
No underlying party filing or electoral-bond transaction file is represented as audited.

rows.scope: Contributions disclosed by a party for its reporting period
rows.does_not_establish: Not automatically total income, all funding flows or proof that a donor influenced a decision.
rows.reference_period: As specified by the individual filing or historical disclosure
rows.source_locator: Announcement identifying Contribution Reports, Audited Annual Accounts and Election Expenditure Statements

rows.scope: Financial accounts for the party’s financial year
rows.does_not_establish: Accounting categories differ from contribution reports and election-period spending; inspect the actual filing.
rows.reference_period: As specified by the individual filing or historical disclosure
rows.source_locator: Announcement identifying Contribution Reports, Audited Annual Accounts and Election Expenditure Statements

rows.scope: Party reporting for a specified election
rows.does_not_establish: Not the same reporting entity or period as an individual candidate’s expense account.
rows.reference_period: As specified by the individual filing or historical disclosure
rows.source_locator: Announcement identifying Contribution Reports, Audited Annual Accounts and Election Expenditure Statements

rows.scope: Candidate-level records under RPA sections 76–78, scoped to Lok Sabha and Assembly elections
rows.does_not_establish: Verify the specific account and election instructions; no ceiling or filing deadline is supplied here.
rows.reference_period: As specified by the individual filing or historical disclosure
rows.source_locator: Sections 76–78, PDF pages 38–39: scope, candidate accounts and lodging

rows.scope: Data ECI announced it uploaded as received from SBI
rows.does_not_establish: Not all political finance and not proof of a quid pro quo; underlying transaction files were not reconstructed here.
rows.reference_period: As specified by the individual filing or historical disclosure
rows.source_locator: 21 March 2024 notice: SBI data uploaded as received, pursuant to court directions

rows.event: ECI announced an online filing facility for three party financial-report categories.
rows.interpretation_limit: Does not establish the completeness of any individual party filing.
rows.source_locator: Announcement identifying Contribution Reports, Audited Annual Accounts and Election Expenditure Statements

rows.event: ECI announced it uploaded SBI electoral-bond data as received pursuant to court directions.
rows.interpretation_limit: Disclosure event, not an independent transaction audit.
rows.source_locator: 21 March 2024 notice: SBI data uploaded as received, pursuant to court directions

rows.event: Supreme Court order distinguished the earlier scheme-invalidity judgment from petitions seeking investigation and discussed ordinary remedies.
rows.interpretation_limit: Not a finding that every donation was criminal or that every transaction was cleared; not a complete case chronology.
rows.source_locator: Opening recap of the 15 February 2024 judgment and paragraphs 15–17 on Article 32 intervention

review_method: Source passages/tables inspected by assistant; transcription and arithmetic validated locally. Not an independent audit.
reference_period: Selected 2023–2024 source events; record-specific periods must be checked
